title: The Public API has no way to list terms or the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the Public API documentation from the developers for the test organization open (the customer requests and the vendor requests).
custom_steps:
1. Look for a request that lists the shop's credit terms or its default.
  2. Open the documentation's request that creates a vendor.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is none: an integrator sends a term name and reads back the saved spelling.

Step 2:

  • It says a vendor created with no credit term starts on COD (no longer "net_30").
  • The vendor requests have no other new credit term field or rule.

The tester reads the Public API documentation in this case and sends no request.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 5 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R7: “The Public API reads, creates and updates a customer's credit term. It has no way to list the shop's terms or its default; an integrator sends a term name and reads back the saved spelling (S10-R3). The vendor API is unchanged except for one default: a vendor created through the Public API with no credit term starts on COD, as New Vendor does (S6-R2), instead of today’s unrecognized "net_30". Vendors created before release keep the term they have.”
  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
